comments.body: Another instance, 2026-11-07 21:00 CST, Muster 0.23.0, Mac: a Claude Code worker (opus medium, pane taffy) had declared report --waiting on two reviewer helpers and ended its turn. A wake for its Codex reviewer's message was typed into its prompt ('[muster] squid+taffy: 1 new (#5) ...') but never submitted; the pane sat idle with that draft for minutes until the integrator pressed Return with pane send --enter.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

comments.body: 2026-11-07 instance (Mac Mini): a parallel-work worker pane, busy mid-turn, was reported to its helper as having 'something typed and not sent' in its prompt (presumably Muster's own wake line), so the helper's report was held until the worker's next post was refused for unread messages.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

comments.body: Another instance, 2026-11-08 (Mac, a parallel-work round in another repo): the integrator's idle Claude Code pane had a wake for one group typed into its prompt at 10:17 and never submitted; every later wake to it was held ("its prompt holds something typed and not sent") for 20+ minutes, until a worker pressed Enter in that pane, which submitted the stuck wake and the integrator resumed.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

comments.body: Instance 2026-11-08 18:19-18:29, Mac, Claude Code 2.1.319: worker plum declared a wait for its Codex reviewer (elder) and ended its turn; a Heads up notice covered its prompt. elder posted its review at about 18:19, then cleared plum's notice itself with `pane send --key 0` and one `--key ctrl+c`. Muster then typed the held wake into plum's prompt but did not submit it, so plum sat 'waiting' for 10 minutes with '[muster] elder+plum: 1 new (#5) ...' unsent in its prompt; `msg who` said 'a wake for it is held because its prompt holds something typed and not sent', which was Muster's own wake. One Return from the integrator submitted it. The ring delivered right after a notice is cleared seems to be the one that is left unsent (see also a_2wLq4e7rc).
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Seen 2026-11-05, Claude Code, Muster 0.21-era daemon. A receiver that had used `report --waiting ... --until-exits` ended its turn at 23:55:58. A post from 23:46 and an urgent one from 23:53 stayed unread: at 00:01 the composer held two concatenated wake notices with no dialog visible, and `msg who` said the request "was rung, and has neither read it nor gone to work". One manual Return started the turn.

Not a_2hL5I8kn2, which was a busy pane. Here the pane had finished its turn. After typing a notice and Return, check that the receiver starts a turn; if only the unsent notice remains once the harness settles, retry Return without typing the notice again.
title: Wake notices can stay unsent in the prompt of a waiting Claude Code pane
